values.summary: Bootstrap #487, obtain design approval, wait for #486 terminal ancestry, bind a FastWork worktree, implement the AWS audit/security baseline surfaces and redacted proof, run focused static/readback validation, obtain exact-head review, publish, and finish when green.

steps.action: Bootstrap and approve the AWS-D audit/security design.
After #486 terminal ancestry, bind the #487 FastWork execution worktree.
Implement account-foundation audit/security Terraform, runbook, redaction, and proof surfaces.
Validate, obtain fresh exact-head review, publish with closing linkage, and finish when green.

invariants: Audit/security baseline does not re-own #486 backend resources
Security findings always have an explicit owner and destination
Retention, encryption, and cost posture are machine-checkable
Retained evidence never includes credentials or token material
risks: CloudTrail, Config, or detection services can create uncontrolled recurring cost if scope is too broad
Detection findings can be enabled without a real owner or destination
Retained AWS evidence can accidentally expose sensitive identifiers or credentials
Account-foundation Terraform can drift into AWS-E adoption or AWS-F runtime-platform scope
stop_conditions: #486 is not terminal and ancestral before bind/implementation
